solver.method: SCP of sparse graph-Laplacian soft-target objective; each node uses exact active-set candidate projection onto source ball, exit halfspace, fixed anchor, and 2mm trust ball; oriented-area rows use cyclic Dykstra; full emitted-F32 area and exact self gates before each accepted iterate

limitations: No exact bone query or material/layer reconstruction included. Exit proposals are geometric first-union suggestions and do not establish anatomical outwardness. A candidate can remain unadmitted even when the listed local gates pass.
